title: From Benchmarks to Production: A Text-to-SQL System for Complex Financial Data
title_zh: 从基准到生产：一种针对复杂金融数据的文本到SQL系统

paragraphs.en: General-purpose T2S systems achieve strong performance on academic benchmarks like Spider and BIRD, where schemas are relatively shallow and column values are often human readable. In production financial databases, where concepts are stored as opaque integer keys rather than human-readable strings, these methods fall below 50%, as even simple queries require multiple joins and filter predicates reference opaque IDs. We present FLINT ( FLINT ), a domain-specialized T2S system that closes this gap through three key components: (1) a lookup agent that dynamically resolves natural-language concepts to question-specific reference table constraints, (2) embedding-based retrieval of structurally similar query templates from a compact, expert-authored bank, and (3) schema linking that prunes a large table schema to the relevant subset by traversing foreign-key chains, rather than relying on name similarity alone. We evaluate on two datasets totaling 359 questions over production financial schemas. FLINT outperforms various state-of-the-art baselines using the same LLM. The system is deployed in production as part of a financial data retrieval service. 1 1 1 https://kensho.com/solutions/adaptive-retrieval

paragraphs.en: T2S , translating natural language questions into executable database queries, has emerged as a useful interface for non-technical users to access structured data. Recent systems have achieved 70-85% accuracy on academic benchmarks such as Spider Yu et al. (2018) and BIRD Li et al. (2023b) through advances in schema linking, multi-agent architectures, and prompt engineering.
paragraphs.zh: T2S（将自然语言问题转换为可执行的数据库查询）已成为非技术用户访问结构化数据的一种实用接口。 近期系统在 Spider Yu et al. (2018) 和 BIRD Li et al. (2023b) 等学术基准测试中，通过模式关联、多智能体架构和提示工程方面的进步，实现了 70-85% 的准确率。

paragraphs.en: However, these results do not transfer to real-world database schemas in the financial sector. Questions about these databases (e.g., a company’s quarterly revenue, the largest M&A deals in a sector) are straightforward to express in natural language, but difficult to translate into production-ready SQL. Commercial financial databases optimize for storage efficiency, not human readability, so financial metrics, period types, and currencies are encoded as integer foreign keys across dozens of normalized reference tables. A single time-series question requires traversing a six-table join chain, and the filters that distinguish “annual revenue” from “quarterly net income” are opaque integers that cannot be inferred from column names alone (detailed examples in App. A.2 and A.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这些结果无法迁移到金融领域的真实世界数据库模式。 关于这些数据库的问题（例如，一家公司的季度收入、某个行业最大的并购交易）用自然语言表达起来很简单，但很难翻译成可直接投入生产的 SQL。 商业金融数据库针对存储效率进行优化，而非人类可读性，因此财务指标、周期类型和货币都以整数字外键的形式编码在数十个规范化参考表中。 一个单一的时间序列问题需要遍历包含六个表的连接链，而区分“年度收入”与“季度净收入”的筛选条件是不透明的整数，仅凭列名无法推断出这些条件（详细示例见附录 A.2 和 A.3）。

paragraphs.en: This setting exposes a gap that academic benchmarks do not measure. In Spider Yu et al. (2018) and BIRD Li et al. (2023b) , the column values are self-describing (e.g. country = ‘USA’ ), the joins are shallow (1-2 on average), and the schemas fit into a single prompt. We evaluate seven state-of-the-art methods on two production financial datasets and find that none exceeds 50% accuracy, despite generating SQL with over 99% execution success. While the queries run, they often return the wrong data due to incorrect reference table filter values.
paragraphs.zh: 这一设置揭示了一个学术基准所未能衡量的问题。在 Spider Yu et al. (2018) 和 BIRD Li et al. (2023b) 中，列的值是自描述的（例如，country = ‘USA’），连接操作较为简单（平均为 1-2 次），且模式可以容纳在单个提示中。我们在两个实际金融数据集上评估了七种最先进的智能体方法，发现尽管生成的 SQL 执行成功率超过 99%，但没有任何一种方法的准确率能超过 50%。虽然这些查询能够执行，但由于参考表的筛选值不正确，它们经常返回错误的数据。

paragraphs.en: We present FLINT ( FLINT ), a domain-specialized T2S system that targets this through three components: (1) a lookup agent that dynamically resolves natural-language concepts to question-specific reference table constraints, (2) embedding-based retrieval over a compact, expert-authored query bank for structural templates, and (3) schema linking that prunes large schemas to relevant subsets, including the bridge tables needed for foreign-key traversal.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 FLINT（FLINT），一个领域专用的 T2S 系统，通过以下三个组件实现这一目标：(1) 一个查询智能体，能够动态地将自然语言概念解析为特定问题的参考表约束；(2) 基于嵌入的检索机制，从由专家编写的紧凑型查询库中获取结构模板；(3) 模式链接机制，可将大型模式裁剪为相关的子集，包括外键遍历所需的桥接表。

paragraphs.en: This design decouples domain knowledge from model weights. When schemas evolve, new metrics are added, or coverage gaps are identified, domain experts update the configuration artifacts directly without retraining or ML engineering involvement. Our architecture addresses normalized schemas that are common across industries, and while we focus on financial data, we validate the generalizability of this approach in additional scientific and industrial domains in App. G .
paragraphs.zh: 这种设计将领域知识与模型权重解耦。 当模式演进、新增指标或发现覆盖范围缺口时，领域专家可以直接更新配置工件，无需重新训练或机器学习工程师的介入。 我们的架构针对跨行业通用的标准化模式；尽管我们专注于金融数据，但我们在附录 G 中通过额外的科学和工业领域验证了该方法的可推广性。

paragraphs.en: Prompt engineering approaches to T2S ( Gao et al., 2024 ; Pourreza and Rafiei, 2023 , further discussion in App. I ) have largely been superseded by multi-agent decomposition, where SQL generation is split across multiple specialized stages before the final query is produced. Recent systems address different failure modes: candidate diversity and selection Talaei et al. (2024) ; Pourreza et al. (2025) , interactive database exploration Wang et al. (2025) ; Pham et al. (2026) , and iterative refinement via execution feedback Deng et al. (2025) . While these strategies reduce structural SQL errors, none includes a dedicated mechanism for resolving opaque reference-table IDs. On normalized schemas in finance, this shared gap is the main source of error (see Section 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 针对 T2S 的提示工程方法（Gao 等人，2024；Pourreza 和 Rafiei，2023，更多讨论见附录 I）在很大程度上已被多智能体分解方法所取代。在这种方法中，SQL 生成被划分为多个专业化阶段，最终查询则在这些阶段之后才生成。近期的系统针对不同的故障模式进行了改进：候选答案的多样性和选择问题（Talaei 等人，2024；Pourreza 等人，2025）；交互式数据库探索（Wang 等人，2025；Pham 等人，2026）；以及通过执行反馈进行迭代优化（Deng 等人，2025）。尽管这些策略减少了结构性的 SQL 错误，但没有任何一种方法包含了专门用于解决不透明引用表 ID 问题的机制。在金融领域的规范化模式中，这一共同存在的缺陷是错误的主要来源（参见第 4.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation methodology and benchmarks remain active research concerns. Spider Yu et al. (2018) compares SQL components structurally via exact set match, rejecting equivalent reformulations. In contrast, BIRD Li et al. (2023b) looks only at query outputs, allowing formatting differences to be conflated with semantic errors. This is a limitation that SpotIt Klopfenstein et al. (2026) quantifies through formal verification, hypothesizing that up to 20% of BIRD evaluation data may be incorrect because test databases coincidentally agree on non-equivalent queries. Our benchmarks differ from Spider and BIRD in both content and evaluation: The schemas feature deep normalization with opaque IDs, mandatory multi-table joins for even simple queries, and implicit domain conventions absent from the natural language. Furthermore, we evaluate through a three-tier pipeline (AST canonicalization, output comparison, and LLM judge) designed to accommodate the many valid reformulations that arise on such schemas. We discuss additional related work in App. I .
paragraphs.zh: 评估方法和基准仍然是活跃的研究议题。Spider Yu 等人 (2018) 通过精确集合匹配对 SQL 组件进行结构性比较，从而拒绝等效的重构形式。 相比之下，BIRD Li 等人 (2023b) 仅关注查询输出，导致格式差异可能被误认为语义错误。 这是 SpotIt Klopfenstein 等人 (2026) 通过形式化验证所量化的一个局限性：他们推测，BIRD 评估数据中最多可能有 20% 的数据存在错误，因为测试数据库在查询不等效的情况下偶然得出了相同结果。 我们的基准在内容和评估方式上均不同于 Spider 和 BIRD：其模式具有深度规范化、不透明的 ID，即使是简单查询也强制要求进行多表连接，并且存在自然语言中未体现的隐含领域约定。 此外，我们通过一个三级流程（AST 规范化、输出比较和 LLM 判断）进行评估，该流程旨在适应此类模式下产生的多种有效重构形式。 我们在附录 I 中讨论了其他相关研究。

paragraphs.en: FLINT decomposes natural language to SQL generation into a pipeline of specialized stages, each addressing a distinct sub-problem. Given a user question q q , the system produces a SQL query s ^ \hat{s} through six stages: lookup, similar query retrieval, entity linking, schema linking, SQL generation, and execution with reflection. Stages without data dependency – lookup and similar query retrieval, followed by entity linking and schema linking – execute in parallel (Fig. 1 ). This parallelism yields median end-to-end latency of 10 - 20s (App. D.12 ).
paragraphs.zh: FLINT 将自然语言到 SQL 的生成过程分解为一系列专门的阶段，每个阶段解决一个独立的子问题。 给定用户问题 q q ，系统通过六个阶段生成 SQL 查询 s ^ \hat{s}：查找、相似查询检索、实体链接、模式链接、SQL 生成以及带反思的执行。 没有数据依赖的阶段——查找和相似查询检索，随后是实体链接和模式链接——并行执行（图 1）。 这种并行性使得端到端延迟的中位数为 10 - 20 秒（附录 D.12）。

paragraphs.en: Constraint generation: The agent executes SELECT queries against the identified production reference table(s), presents retrieved rows to the LLM, and asks it to produce the appropriate SQL filters. paragraphs.en: Entity linking resolves natural-language mentions (company names, ticker symbols) to the opaque integer keys used in the database. Without this step, the model has no path from a mention like “Nvidia” to the correct numeric identifier, as the core data tables contain no human-readable name column, and fuzzy string matching against 20 million+ entities is unreliable at production scale. FLINT delegates resolution to an external entity disambiguation service, Kensho Link, 3 3 3 https://kensho.com/solutions/core-ai-capabilities#link that handles name variations and identifier-type disambiguation, returning canonical integer IDs. Resolved IDs are injected as concrete WHERE -clause constraints into the generation prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 实体链接将自然语言中的提及（公司名称、股票代码）映射到数据库中使用的不透明整数键。 如果没有这一步，模型就无法从“Nvidia”这样的提及中定位到正确的数值标识符，因为核心数据表不包含人类可读的名称列，而在生产规模下对超过 2000 万个实体进行模糊字符串匹配并不可靠。 FLINT 将解析任务委托给外部的实体消歧服务 Kensho Link（3 3 3 https://kensho.com/solutions/core-ai-capabilities#link），该服务可处理名称变体和标识符类型的消歧，并返回标准的整数 ID。 解析后的 ID 会被作为具体的 WHERE 子句约束注入到生成提示中。

paragraphs.en: Schema linking determines which tables, columns, join conditions, and filter predicates are required for the query. Given the question, reference table constraints, lookup IDs, and retrieved examples, the LLM selects the relevant subset of the schema. This is challenging because the answer rarely lives in a single table and reaching it requires identifying intermediate tables that serve only as join bridges. For example, retrieving a stock price for a company requires resolving the company’s security, then its trading item, before reaching the price table: Company → \rightarrow Security → \rightarrow TradingItem → \rightarrow PriceEquity .
paragraphs.zh: 模式关联会确定查询需要哪些表、列、连接条件和过滤谓词。 根据问题、参考表约束、查找 ID 和检索到的示例，大语言模型会选择模式中的相关子集。 这具有挑战性，因为答案很少存在于单个表中，而要获得它，就需要识别出仅用作连接桥梁的中间表。 例如，要获取某家公司的股价，需要先确定该公司的证券，再确定其交易项，最后才能到达价格表：公司 → \rightarrow 证券 → \rightarrow 交易项 → \rightarrow 价格权益。

paragraphs.en: The prompt includes: (1) the full database schema with column descriptions and documented join paths, (2) lookup constraints from the Lookup Agent (resolving which integer IDs to filter on), (3) domain-specific instructions encoding implicit conventions (e.g., default temporal granularity, which of several price columns to use, required flag filters for primary listings), and (4) retrieved examples with their reasoning traces.
paragraphs.zh: 提示包括：(1) 完整的数据库模式，包含列描述和已记录的连接路径；(2) 来自查找智能体的查找约束（用于确定需要筛选的整数 ID）；(3) 编码了隐式惯例的领域特定指令（例如，默认的时间粒度、多个价格列中应使用哪一个、主列表所需的标志筛选条件等）；以及 (4) 已检索到的示例及其推理轨迹。

paragraphs.en: The LLM outputs a structured representation consisting of selected columns, join conditions, and filters. This decouples what to query from how to write SQL : Schema linking reasons about table selection while generation handles syntax. Since schema linking sees the full schema, this design suits our target of a fixed, curated schema.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型会输出一个结构化表示，其中包含选定的列、连接条件和过滤器。 这种设计将“查询什么”与“如何编写 SQL”分离开来：模式关联负责处理表选择的推理，而生成过程则负责处理语法。 由于模式关联能够看到完整的模式，因此这种设计适合我们使用固定且经过精心挑选的模式这一目标。

paragraphs.en: Given schema links, entity IDs, and SQL exemplars, the LLM generates the final query. Domain constraints are enforced via the prompt: Use only specified tables and columns, apply entity IDs as concrete filters, include contextual columns (company name, currency) for interpretability, and follow the target SQL dialect. Before execution, a safety validator ensures the query only accesses allowed schemas and tables, preventing unintended data exposure.
paragraphs.zh: 基于给定的模式链接、实体 ID 和 SQL 示例，大语言模型生成最终查询。 通过提示词强制执行领域约束：仅使用指定的表和列，将实体 ID 作为具体筛选条件应用，包含上下文相关的列（公司名称、货币）以确保可解释性，并遵循目标 SQL 方言。 在执行前，安全验证器会确保查询仅访问允许的模式和表，从而防止意外数据泄露。

sents.zh: 基于给定的模式链接、实体 ID 和 SQL 示例，大语言模型生成最终查询。

sents.en: Before execution, a safety validator ensures the query only accesses allowed schemas and tables, preventing unintended data exposure.

paragraphs.en: The query is executed against the database. On execution success, results are returned directly. On failure, the system enters a reflection loop : The LLM receives the original question, failed SQL, and database error, then regenerates with targeted corrections. This reflection step is particularly useful for complex schemas, where execution errors often stem from localized mistakes, such as missing join conditions, incorrect aliases, or column typos, which become diagnosable once the error message is available. While we allow only one reflection attempt to stay within production latency constraints, this is configurable for use cases where accuracy is prioritized over response time.
paragraphs.zh: 该查询将在数据库上执行。 执行成功时，结果将直接返回。 如果执行失败，系统将进入一个反思循环：大语言模型会接收原始问题、失败的 SQL 语句和数据库错误信息，然后进行针对性修正并重新生成。 对于复杂的数据库模式而言，这一反思步骤尤其有用，因为执行错误通常源于局部性问题，例如缺少连接条件、别名不正确或列名拼写错误；一旦获得错误信息，这些问题便可以被诊断出来。 尽管为了控制生产环境中的延迟，我们仅允许一次反思尝试，但在准确性比响应时间更重要的使用场景中，这一设置是可以配置的。

sents.en: FLINT adapts to new datasets without fine-tuning or retraining.
sents.zh: FLINT 无需微调或重新训练即可适应新数据集。

sents.en: Configuration requires four artifacts:
sents.zh: 配置需要四个组件：

paragraphs.en: A schema CSV mapping tables and columns to descriptions and join-path documentation.
paragraphs.zh: 一个将表、列与描述及连接路径文档映射起来的 CSV 模式。

paragraphs.en: A list of reference tables for the Lookup Agent (identifying tables with categorical IDs).
paragraphs.zh: 查找智能体（用于识别具有类别 ID 的表）的参考表列表。

paragraphs.en: A query bank of 15–30 examples covering major query patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 一个包含 15–30 个示例的查询库，涵盖主要查询模式。

paragraphs.zh: 用于模式关联与生成的领域特定指令提示（编码隐式约定）。

paragraphs.en: Because these artifacts are structured domain knowledge, they are authored by subject-matter experts rather than ML engineers. In our experience a moderate-complexity dataset takes roughly one person-week to configure, and a complex one (many reference tables, several implicit conventions) takes two to three weeks including iterative refinement; adding a new example for a novel pattern is ∼ 30 {\sim}30 minutes (App. B ). paragraphs.en: The Financials dataset covers company intelligence, market data, financial metrics, and securities across global public companies. The schema consists of 24 tables (8 core data tables, 16 reference tables). Financial values are not stored with human-readable labels but metric names, period types, unit types, and currencies are each encoded as integer foreign keys into separate reference tables. A typical query requires joining 6 tables; complex screening queries require up to 13 joins. paragraphs.en: The 359 evaluation questions are drawn from a pool of production queries logged over 6 months, deduplicated and filtered to ensure coverage across query categories, table usage, and difficulty levels. Each question is paired with a gold SQL query written by database domain experts. 4 4 4 This may bias the benchmark toward questions with known SQL solutions, which we consider acceptable for measuring system coverage of production use cases. The gold queries enforce constraints central to correctness on normalized schemas: explicit joins, required flag filters for selecting primary listings, currency normalization for cross-country comparisons, and correct temporal-granularity constraints. These are precisely the constraints that general-purpose T2S systems fail to satisfy (Sec. 4.3 ). While we focus on the financial domain, the constraints we address are present in other domains. We validate the generalizability of our system on two external benchmarks spanning various scientific and industrial domains in App. G .
paragraphs.zh: 这 359 道评估题选自过去 6 个月中记录的生产查询池，经过去重和筛选，以确保覆盖各类查询类别、表使用方式及难度等级。 每道题都配有一个由数据库领域专家编写的标准 SQL 查询。4 4 4 这可能会使基准测试偏向于那些已有已知 SQL 解的题目，但我们认为这对于衡量系统对生产用例的覆盖能力是可以接受的。 这些标准查询在规范化模式上施加了正确性相关的核心约束：显式连接、用于选择主要列表的必要标志过滤器、用于跨国比较的货币标准化，以及正确的时间粒度约束。 这些正是通用型 T2S 系统无法满足的约束（第 4.3 节）。 尽管我们专注于金融领域，但我们所处理的约束也存在于其他领域中。 我们在附录 G 中通过两个涵盖多个科学和工业领域的外部基准测试，验证了本系统的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Execution: We execute both gold and generated queries against the production database; execution failures score 0 immediately.
paragraphs.zh: 执行：我们将黄金查询和生成的查询均提交至生产数据库执行；执行失败将立即得 0 分。

paragraphs.en: Heuristics: We parse both queries into abstract syntax trees using sqlglot , apply canonicalizing transformations (alias normalization, date function standardization, JOIN reordering), and compute tree edit distance. Queries that differ only in aliasing, column order, or semantically equivalent reformulations (e.g., CTE vs. subquery) are matched. For queries that are not matched via AST, gold columns are checked against the generated columns via case-insensitive name alignment, and values are compared with order-invariant set equality. This heuristic resolves almost 60% of cases at negligible cost.
paragraphs.zh: 启发式方法：我们使用 sqlglot 将两个查询都解析为抽象语法树，应用规范化转换（别名规范化、日期函数标准化、JOIN 重排序），并计算树编辑距离。 仅因别名、列顺序不同或语义上等价的改写形式（例如 CTE 与子查询）而不同的查询会被匹配。 对于无法通过 AST 匹配的查询，我们会通过不区分大小写的名称对齐方式，将参考列与生成的列进行比对，并通过顺序无关的集合相等性比较其值。 这种启发式方法以极低的成本解决了近 60% 的情况。

paragraphs.en: All methods produce valid SQL ( ≥ \geq 99% execution success) but fail semantically: The dominant error is syntactically correct queries with wrong filter values. No baseline exceeds 50% accuracy, despite achieving substantially higher performance on Spider/BIRD where column values are often semantically informative (e.g. country = ‘USA’ ). On our schemas, mapping from natural language (“annual revenue”) to opaque integer IDs requires querying reference tables that no baseline provides. CHESS k = 10 k{=}10 gains 8.5 points over k = 1 k{=}1 on Financials via sampling diversity (occasionally hitting correct IDs), but self-consistency cannot fix errors shared across all candidates. Among baseline failures, 64–96% contain incorrect IDs (App. D ). These gaps are well outside sampling noise: Wilson 95% intervals on FLINT are 68.8 % ​ [ 62.4 , 74.5 ] 68.8\%\,[62.4,74.5] (Financials) and 65.2 % ​ [ 56.9 , 72.6 ] 65.2\%\,[56.9,72.6] (Transactions), and the margin over the strongest baseline exceeds them by a wide margin; the judge’s ± 4 \pm 4 -point worst case cannot close a gap this size. Moreover, FLINT is the fastest system evaluated, completing queries in 10–20s median latency, faster than all seven baselines (Fig. 5 ).

paragraphs.en: We presented FLINT ( FLINT ), a T2S system designed for production financial databases with deep schema, opaque integer keys as values, and questions that carry implicit domain constraints absent from the natural language. FLINT combines schema linking, example retrieval, entity resolution, domain-specific prompt rules, and execution-based reflection into a single-pass pipeline that runs in 10–20 seconds per query. On two proprietary financial benchmarks, FLINT outperforms the seven academic baselines. Across four additional scientific and medical domains, the same architecture generalizes with only minimal changes. Our results suggest that the gap between academic T2S benchmarks and production deployment is not primarily about SQL generation capability, but about the surrounding domain knowledge: knowing which tables to join, what values mean, and the intent of user questions. FLINT ’s architecture offers one reusable pattern for closing that gap.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 FLINT（FLINT），一个专为复杂金融数据库设计的 T2S 系统。这类数据库具有深层模式结构、以不透明整数键作为值，以及自然语言中未体现的隐含领域约束问题。 FLINT 将模式关联、示例检索、实体解析、领域特定提示规则和基于执行的反思整合为单阶段处理流程，每条查询的处理时间仅为 10–20 秒。 在两个专有金融基准测试中，FLINT 的表现优于七种学术基准模型。 在另外四个科学和医学领域，该架构只需极小改动即可实现良好泛化。 我们的研究结果表明，学术 T2S 基准与生产部署之间的差距主要并非源于 SQL 生成能力，而是取决于相关的领域知识：例如知道哪些表需要关联、各个值的含义以及用户问题的意图。 FLINT 的架构为弥合这一差距提供了一种可复用的模式。

paragraphs.en: FLINT ’s domain rules are manually authored by subject matter experts familiar with each schema’s conventions. While effective, this introduces a per-domain configuration cost that does not scale automatically to new databases without human effort. Similarly, the retrieval component requires a curated query bank. On a new schema with no historical queries, this component is unavailable and accuracy degrades. One component of our evaluation pipeline uses an LLM as judge for semantic equivalence; while we validate it against human annotations on a held-out subset, its agreement is imperfect and may introduce noise into reported accuracy. Finally, FLINT operates in a single-turn setting: It generates one SQL query per natural language question and does not support conversational refinement such as follow-up filters or corrections that reference prior context.

sents.en: Finally, FLINT operates in a single-turn setting: It generates one SQL query per natural language question and does not support conversational refinement such as follow-up filters or corrections that reference prior context.
sents.zh: 最后，FLINT 在单轮交互模式下运行：它对每个自然语言问题生成一条 SQL 查询，不支持对话式的优化，例如引用先前上下文的后续筛选或修正。

paragraphs.en: These examples illustrate three properties that make our benchmarks challenging for general-purpose T2S systems:

paragraphs.en: Deep normalization : Even simple questions require resolving opaque integer IDs (e.g., dataItemId = 28 for revenue, periodTypeId = 1 for annual) from lookup tables. Without a dedicated lookup mechanism, models cannot produce correct filter predicates (Fig. 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 深度归一化：即使是简单的问题，也需要通过查找表解析不透明的整数 ID（例如，收入对应 dataItemId = 28，年度对应 periodTypeId = 1）。 如果没有专门的查找机制，模型就无法生成正确的过滤谓词（图 4）。

paragraphs.en: Our benchmark (359 questions) is smaller than Spider (1,034 dev) or BIRD (1,534 dev). We argue this is sufficient for two reasons. First, both datasets share a single fixed schema, eliminating the cross-database variance that inflates sample size requirements in multi-schema benchmarks. Second, a 95% Clopper-Pearson confidence interval at 77% accuracy with n = 221 n{=}221 is ± \pm 5.5 points, narrow enough to distinguish FLINT from all baselines at p < 0.001 p<0.001 . The benchmark is not intended to estimate fine-grained performance differences between systems within a few points of each other; rather, it is designed to measure whether domain-specialized infrastructure closes the gap that general-purpose methods cannot.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的基准测试（359个问题）比Spider（1,034个开发集问题）或BIRD（1,534个开发集问题）的规模更小。 我们认为这足以说明问题，原因有二。 首先，这两个数据集都共享一个固定的模式，从而消除了多模式基准测试中因跨数据库差异而导致的样本量需求膨胀问题。 其次，当n = 221时，在77%准确率下，95%的Clopper-Pearson置信区间为±5.5个百分点，这个范围足够窄，能够在p < 0.001的水平上区分FLINT与所有基线模型。 该基准测试并非用于估计系统之间细微的性能差异（在几个百分点以内）；相反，它旨在衡量领域专用基础设施是否能够有效弥补通用方法无法填补的差距。

paragraphs.en: The bulk of configuration effort is authoring the query bank: relevant questions, their gold SQL, and a reasoning trace. Each takes longer than a routine evaluation question (which averages ∼ 30 {\sim}30 minutes including 2–3 review rounds) because of the chain-of-thought walkthrough, roughly 12 person-hours for Transactions and 18 person-hours for Financials. The schema CSV is usually straightforward, since production databases already carry metadata or customer-facing documentation. Instruction prompts and example traces add ∼ 4 {\sim}4 – 8 8 person-hours for a complex schema.

paragraphs.en: Evaluating T2S correctness is fundamentally harder than string matching: Syntactically different queries can produce identical results, while structurally similar queries can return different data due to a single wrong filter value. Standard benchmarks sidestep this with execution accuracy (run both queries, compare outputs), but this is insufficient for production-scale schemas where result-set equality is sensitive to row ordering, null handling, and floating-point precision.
paragraphs.zh: 评估 T2S 的正确性在根本上比字符串匹配更难：语法上不同的查询可能产生完全相同的结果，而结构上相似的查询则可能因单个过滤值错误而返回不同的数据。 标准基准测试通过执行准确性（运行两个查询并比较输出）来规避这一问题，但对于生产级模式而言，这种做法并不充分，因为结果集的相等性对行顺序、空值处理以及浮点精度极为敏感。

paragraphs.en: Spider Yu et al. (2018) uses exact set match (ESM): The gold and predicted SQL are decomposed into components ( SELECT , WHERE , GROUP BY , ORDER BY ) and compared structurally. ESM is brittle, it rejects semantically equivalent queries with different syntactic structure (e.g., a subquery reformulated as a JOIN , or an EXISTS replaced by IN ). BIRD Li et al. (2023b) improves on this by using execution accuracy (EX): Both queries run against the database and the result sets are compared. However, EX treats any difference in output as failure, even when differences arise from column ordering, alias naming, or equivalent NULL handling.
paragraphs.zh: Spider Yu 等人 (2018) 使用了精确集合匹配（ESM）：将黄金 SQL 和预测的 SQL 分解为各个组件（SELECT、WHERE、GROUP BY、ORDER BY），并从结构上进行比较。 ESM 较为脆弱，它会拒绝语义等价但语法结构不同的查询（例如，子查询被重构为 JOIN，或 EXISTS 被替换为 IN）。BIRD Li 等人 (2023b) 通过采用执行准确性（EX）对此进行了改进：两种查询都在数据库上运行，然后对结果集进行比较。 然而，EX 将任何输出差异都视为失败，即使这些差异源于列的顺序、别名命名或等价的 NULL 处理方式。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation addresses both limitations. We do not rely on structural matching alone (unlike ESM), since our queries have many valid reformulations (CTEs vs. subqueries, different join orderings, aliasing choices). paragraphs.en: A single evaluation method is insufficient for normalized financial schemas. Consider a query retrieving Apple’s annual revenue: the gold SQL joins through ciqCompany , ciqSecurity , ciqTradingItem , ciqFinPeriod , ciqFinancialData , and ciqDataItem with specific filter predicates. A correct prediction might use different aliases, reorder joins, wrap part of the logic in a CTE, or select columns in a different order, all the while producing identical results.
paragraphs.zh: 对于规范化的金融模式而言，单一的评价方法并不足够。 考虑一个查询，用于获取苹果公司的年度收入：其黄金标准 SQL 通过 ciqCompany、ciqSecurity、ciqTradingItem、ciqFinPeriod、ciqFinancialData 和 ciqDataItem 进行连接，并带有特定的过滤谓词。 正确的预测可能会使用不同的别名、重新排列连接顺序、将部分逻辑包裹在 CTE 中，或以不同顺序选择列，但所有这些操作最终都会产生完全相同的结果。

sents.en: A single evaluation method is insufficient for normalized financial schemas.
sents.zh: 对于规范化的金融模式而言，单一的评价方法并不足够。

sents.en: Consider a query retrieving Apple’s annual revenue: the gold SQL joins through ciqCompany , ciqSecurity , ciqTradingItem , ciqFinPeriod , ciqFinancialData , and ciqDataItem with specific filter predicates.
sents.zh: 考虑一个查询，用于获取苹果公司的年度收入：其黄金标准 SQL 通过 ciqCompany、ciqSecurity、ciqTradingItem、ciqFinPeriod、ciqFinancialData 和 ciqDataItem 进行连接，并带有特定的过滤谓词。

sents.en: A correct prediction might use different aliases, reorder joins, wrap part of the logic in a CTE, or select columns in a different order, all the while producing identical results.
sents.zh: 正确的预测可能会使用不同的别名、重新排列连接顺序、将部分逻辑包裹在 CTE 中，或以不同顺序选择列，但所有这些操作最终都会产生完全相同的结果。

paragraphs.en: Both return identical rows, but the CTE node and rearranged self-join aliases produce an irreducible tree difference. No single comparison method handles all such cases, motivating a cascading pipeline where each tier catches what the previous one misses.
paragraphs.zh: 两者返回的行完全相同，但 CTE 节点和重排后的自连接别名会产生一个不可简化的树差异。 没有任何一种比较方法能够处理所有此类情况，因此需要采用级联式流水线，让每一层捕获前一层未能捕获的内容。

sents.en: Both return identical rows, but the CTE node and rearranged self-join aliases produce an irreducible tree difference.
sents.zh: 两者返回的行完全相同，但 CTE 节点和重排后的自连接别名会产生一个不可简化的树差异。

sents.en: No single comparison method handles all such cases, motivating a cascading pipeline where each tier catches what the previous one misses.
sents.zh: 没有任何一种比较方法能够处理所有此类情况，因此需要采用级联式流水线，让每一层捕获前一层未能捕获的内容。

paragraphs.en: The first tier parses both gold and generated queries into abstract syntax trees using sqlglot and applies canonicalizing transformations: alias normalization (replacing all aliases with canonical names derived from the underlying table), date function standardization, JOIN reordering (sorting inner joins by table name), and predicate normalization (canonicalizing commutative predicates and IN -clause value ordering). After canonicalization, tree edit distance determines whether the remaining differences are semantically meaningful. For self-joins, all alias permutations are tested, tractable for our schema’s typical 2–3 self-join aliases. Queries that are structurally equivalent modulo these transformations are matched without execution.
paragraphs.zh: 第一层使用 sqlglot 将黄金查询和生成的查询都解析为抽象语法树，并应用标准化转换：别名规范化（将所有别名替换为源自底层表的规范名称）、日期函数标准化、JOIN 重排序（按表名对内连接进行排序）以及谓词规范化（对交换律谓词和 IN 子句中的值顺序进行标准化）。 在标准化之后，通过树编辑距离判断剩余差异是否具有语义意义。 对于自连接，系统会测试所有别名的排列组合；鉴于我们模式通常只有 2–3 个自连接别名，这一过程是可行的。 在这些转换下结构等效的查询无需执行即可被匹配。

paragraphs.en: When AST matching fails, the second tier executes both queries against the production database and compares outputs. Execution failures score 0 immediately. For successful queries, gold columns are matched to generated columns via select clauses from SQLs or case-insensitive name matching, falling back to data-type and value-distribution similarity for ambiguous cases. Values are compared with order-invariant set equality, and numeric comparisons apply a relative tolerance of 10 − 6 10^{-6} for floating-point differences.
paragraphs.zh: 当 AST 匹配失败时，第二层会对生产数据库执行两条查询，并比较其输出结果。 执行失败会立即得 0 分。 对于成功执行的查询，通过 SQL 中的 select 子句或不区分大小写的名称匹配，将黄金列与生成的列进行匹配；在存在歧义的情况下，则退而使用数据类型和值分布的相似性进行比较。 值的比较采用顺序无关的集合相等性判断，数值比较则对浮点数差异应用 10^{-6} 的相对容差。

sents.zh: 当 AST 匹配失败时，第二层会对生产数据库执行两条查询，并比较其输出结果。

paragraphs.en: When output tables still differ, the third tier invokes an LLM judge that receives the original question, gold and generated results. The judge determines semantic equivalence in context, handling cases where column names differ but values match, results are formatted differently. We manually validated 50 randomly sampled judge decisions and found 94% agreement with human annotators (47/50 correct, 2 false positives, 1 false negative).
paragraphs.zh: 当输出的表格仍然存在差异时，第三层会调用一个 LLM 裁判，该裁判接收原始问题、标准答案和生成的结果。 裁判会在上下文中判断语义等价性，处理列名不同但值相同或结果格式不同的情况。 我们手动验证了 50 个随机抽取的裁判决策，发现与人类标注者的同意率达到了 94%（47/50 正确，2 个假阳性，1 个假阴性）。

paragraphs.en: All baseline methods were originally evaluated on Spider Yu et al. (2018) or BIRD Li et al. (2023b) , which feature flat schemas with 1–3 joins per query. Adapting them to our heavily-normalized financial databases (6+ joins on average, 16+ reference tables) required both infrastructure decisions and architectural choices. This appendix documents the adaptations made and the rationale behind each.

paragraphs.en: Entity linking: Company name disambiguation via an external service (Kensho Link) that resolves natural-language entity references (e.g., “Nvidia” → \to companyId=32307 ). Methods that instead explore the database directly (MAC-SQL) achieve equivalent resolution through interactive queries.

paragraphs.zh: CTE 注入：黄金 SQL 查询引用了用于货币转换和时间标准化的物化 CTE。 这些 CTE 在评估时会被注入到黄金查询和预测查询中，它们是基础设施特定的，而非模型输出。

paragraphs.en: Zero-shot: The full schema (all tables and columns with descriptions) and entity IDs from the external linking service are provided as prompt context. The model generates SQL in a single pass with no examples, no lookup, no schema linking, and no reflection.
paragraphs.zh: 零样本：完整的模式（所有带有描述的表和列）以及来自外部链接服务的实体 ID 都会作为提示上下文提供。 模型会一次性生成 SQL，无需示例、无需查询、无需模式链接，也无需反思。

paragraphs.en: Entity linking is not provided. CHESS handles entity resolution through its own schema-value matching and column-value retrieval modules.

paragraphs.zh: DAIL-SQL Gao 等人 （2024）通过基于词元的相似性选择和结构化提示格式，将模式表示与上下文示例分离，从而引入问题-SQL 示例选择方法。

paragraphs.zh: DAIL-SQL 是一种无需自身管道基础设施的提示工程方法。 我们在自己的管道中实现了它，并提供：

sents.en: DAIL-SQL is a prompt-engineering method without its own pipeline infrastructure.
sents.zh: DAIL-SQL 是一种无需自身管道基础设施的提示工程方法。

sents.en: We implement it within our pipeline, providing:
sents.zh: 我们在自己的管道中实现了它，并提供：

paragraphs.en: Schema linking via embedding-based retrieval to identify relevant tables.
paragraphs.zh: 通过基于嵌入的检索建立模式关联，以识别相关表格。

paragraphs.en: Lookup agent for reference-table constraint resolution (shared infrastructure).
paragraphs.zh: 用于参考表约束解析的查找智能体（共享基础设施）。

paragraphs.en: Entity linking for company name disambiguation (shared infrastructure).
paragraphs.zh: 公司名消歧义的实体链接（共享基础设施）。

paragraphs.zh: 从查询库中检索相似查询（DAIL-SQL 的“示例选择”步骤）。

paragraphs.en: DAIL-style prompts: generic schema linking instructions and SQL generation prompts without domain-specific rules (no currency conversion hints, no period-type defaults, no metric disambiguation guidance).
paragraphs.zh: DAIL风格提示：通用方案，将指令与SQL生成提示关联起来，且不含领域特定规则（无货币转换提示、无日期类型默认设置、无度量单位消歧指南）。

paragraphs.en: We preserve DAIL-SQL’s prompt-level contribution (generic prompts + example selection) while providing the infrastructure necessary to operate on our schema, without entity linking, no method can resolve company names against a 20 million-company table. This gives DAIL-SQL a stronger starting point than it would have with its original prompts alone, making our comparison conservative.

paragraphs.en: DIN-SQL Pourreza and Rafiei (2023) decomposes T2S into sub-tasks: schema linking, query classification (easy/medium/hard), and difficulty-aware SQL generation with self-correction.
paragraphs.zh: DIN-SQL Pourreza 和 Rafiei（2023）将 T2S 分解为若干子任务：模式链接、查询分类（简单/中等/困难）以及具备自我修正能力的难度感知 SQL 生成。

paragraphs.en: Like DAIL-SQL, DIN-SQL is a prompt-engineering approach. We implement it within our pipeline:
paragraphs.zh: 与 DAIL-SQL 类似，DIN-SQL 是一种提示工程方法。 我们在我们的流程中实现了它：

sents.en: Like DAIL-SQL, DIN-SQL is a prompt-engineering approach.
sents.zh: 与 DAIL-SQL 类似，DIN-SQL 是一种提示工程方法。

sents.en: We implement it within our pipeline:
sents.zh: 我们在我们的流程中实现了它：

paragraphs.en: Same shared infrastructure as DAIL-SQL (entity linking, lookup agent, similar query retrieval).
paragraphs.zh: 与 DAIL-SQL 共享相同的基础设施（实体链接、查询智能体、相似查询检索）。

paragraphs.en: DIN-SQL-style prompts: step-by-step schema linking instructions and classification-aware generation prompts.
paragraphs.zh: DIN-SQL 风格提示：分步模式链接指令和分类感知生成提示。

paragraphs.en: Self-correction with 1 reflection attempt (matching the DIN-SQL paper’s self-correction step).
paragraphs.zh: 使用 1 次反思尝试进行自我修正（与 DIN-SQL 论文中的自我修正步骤一致）。

paragraphs.en: We preserve DIN-SQL’s key contribution: decomposition into classification-aware sub-tasks with self-correction through the prompt structure and single reflection attempt. The shared infrastructure gives DIN-SQL the same advantages as DAIL-SQL, making this a conservative comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保留了 DIN-SQL 的关键贡献：通过提示结构和单次反思尝试，将其分解为具备分类意识的子任务并实现自我修正。 共享的基础架构使 DIN-SQL 获得了与 DAIL-SQL 相同的优势，因此这是一次保守的比较。

paragraphs.en: MAC-SQL Wang et al. (2025) proposes a Selector → \to Decomposer → \to Refiner architecture where the Decomposer has interactive database access through a multi-turn tool-calling loop.
paragraphs.zh: MAC-SQL Wang 等人 （2025）提出了一种“选择器 → 分解器 → 精炼器”的架构，其中分解器通过多轮工具调用循环与数据库进行交互。

sents.en: MAC-SQL Wang et al.
sents.zh: MAC-SQL Wang 等人

sents.en: (2025) proposes a Selector → \to Decomposer → \to Refiner architecture where the Decomposer has interactive database access through a multi-turn tool-calling loop.
sents.zh: （2025）提出了一种“选择器 → 分解器 → 精炼器”的架构，其中分解器通过多轮工具调用循环与数据库进行交互。

paragraphs.en: We implement MAC-SQL as a standalone pipeline, independent of FLINT ’s infrastructure:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 MAC-SQL 实现为一个独立的流程，与 FLINT 的基础设施无关：

paragraphs.en: Selector: Single LLM call that receives the full schema (all tables and columns with descriptions) and returns a pruned subset relevant to the question. No embedding-based retrieval, only pure LLM schema selection.
paragraphs.zh: 选择器：单次 LLM 调用，接收完整的模式（所有表格和带有描述的列），并返回与问题相关的精简子集。 不基于嵌入进行检索，仅通过纯 LLM 进行模式选择。

sents.en: Selector: Single LLM call that receives the full schema (all tables and columns with descriptions) and returns a pruned subset relevant to the question.
sents.zh: 选择器：单次 LLM 调用，接收完整的模式（所有表格和带有描述的列），并返回与问题相关的精简子集。

sents.en: No embedding-based retrieval, only pure LLM schema selection.
sents.zh: 不基于嵌入进行检索，仅通过纯 LLM 进行模式选择。

paragraphs.en: Decomposer: Multi-turn agentic loop with two tools: execute_sql (run intermediate queries against Snowflake, returns truncated results) and submit_final_sql (terminate with final answer). Budget of 5 intermediate queries. The model explores reference tables, verifies column values, and tests subqueries before submitting.
paragraphs.zh: 分解器：多轮智能体循环，配备两种工具：execute_sql（在 Snowflake 上执行中间查询，返回截断结果）和 submit_final_sql（以最终答案结束）。 预算为 5 次中间查询。 模型在提交前会探索参考表、验证列值并测试子查询。

sents.en: Decomposer: Multi-turn agentic loop with two tools: execute_sql (run intermediate queries against Snowflake, returns truncated results) and submit_final_sql (terminate with final answer).
sents.zh: 分解器：多轮智能体循环，配备两种工具：execute_sql（在 Snowflake 上执行中间查询，返回截断结果）和 submit_final_sql（以最终答案结束）。

sents.en: Budget of 5 intermediate queries.
sents.zh: 预算为 5 次中间查询。

sents.en: The model explores reference tables, verifies column values, and tests subqueries before submitting.
sents.zh: 模型在提交前会探索参考表、验证列值并测试子查询。

paragraphs.en: Refiner: If the final SQL fails execution, a single-shot LLM call attempts to fix it given the error message. Maximum 2 retry attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 优化器：如果最终的 SQL 执行失败，系统会调用一次 LLM，根据错误消息尝试修复该 SQL。 最多重试 2 次。

sents.en: Refiner: If the final SQL fails execution, a single-shot LLM call attempts to fix it given the error message.

paragraphs.zh: 无实体链接，无查询智能体，无相似查询检索，无模式链接嵌入。

Instead of resolving entities via an external service, the model queries the database directly (e.g., SELECT companyId FROM ciqCompany WHERE companyName ILIKE ’%Nvidia%’ ). This means MAC-SQL does not require Kensho Link infrastructure, achieving entity resolution through interactive exploration.

paragraphs.en: Chase-SQL Pourreza et al. (2025) generates multiple candidate SQL queries using diverse reasoning strategies and selects the best one through pairwise comparison.
paragraphs.zh: Chase-SQL Pourreza 等人 （2025）利用多种推理策略生成多个候选 SQL 查询，并通过成对比较选出最佳查询。

sents.zh: Chase-SQL Pourreza 等人

sents.en: (2025) generates multiple candidate SQL queries using diverse reasoning strategies and selects the best one through pairwise comparison.
sents.zh: （2025）利用多种推理策略生成多个候选 SQL 查询，并通过成对比较选出最佳查询。

paragraphs.en: We implement Chase-SQL as a standalone pipeline:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Chase-SQL 实现为一个独立的流程：

paragraphs.en: Divide & Conquer CoT: Decomposes the question into sub-problems, solves each, combines via CTEs.
paragraphs.zh: 分治 CoT：将问题分解为子问题，分别求解，并通过 CTE 进行整合。

paragraphs.en: Query Plan CoT: Reasons through execution plan steps (scan → \to filter → \to join → \to aggregate → \to project).
paragraphs.zh: 查询计划 CoT：逐步推理执行计划的各个步骤（扫描 → \to 过滤 → \to 连接 → \to 聚合 → \to 投影）。

paragraphs.en: Online Synthetic: Generates 3 similar question-SQL examples on the fly, then uses them as few-shot context.
paragraphs.zh: 在线合成：即时生成 3 个类似的“问题-SQL”示例，然后将其用作少样本上下文。

paragraphs.en: Query Fixer: Failed candidates receive up to 2 retry attempts with the error message.
paragraphs.zh: 查询修复器：失败的候选项将收到最多 2 次重试机会，并附带错误消息。

paragraphs.en: Pairwise Selection: All executable candidates are compared in a tournament. Each pair is evaluated by an LLM judge that sees both queries, their results (first rows), and the original question. The candidate with the most wins is selected.
paragraphs.zh: 成对选择：所有可执行的候选项都通过锦标赛方式进行比较。 每对候选项都由一个大型语言模型（LLM）裁判进行评估，该裁判能看到两个查询、它们的结果（第一行数据）以及原始问题。 获胜次数最多的候选项将被选中。

sents.en: Pairwise Selection: All executable candidates are compared in a tournament.
sents.zh: 成对选择：所有可执行的候选项都通过锦标赛方式进行比较。

sents.en: Each pair is evaluated by an LLM judge that sees both queries, their results (first rows), and the original question.
sents.zh: 每对候选项都由一个大型语言模型（LLM）裁判进行评估，该裁判能看到两个查询、它们的结果（第一行数据）以及原始问题。

sents.en: The candidate with the most wins is selected.
sents.zh: 获胜次数最多的候选项将被选中。

paragraphs.zh: 所有生成器都以文本形式接收完整的模式。 没有模式关联，没有实体关联，也没有查询智能体。

Unlike MAC-SQL, Chase-SQL has no mechanism for interactive database exploration or entity resolution, instead generating SQL in a single pass, making it more vulnerable to reference-table resolution failures.

paragraphs.en: FlexSQL proposes a five-stage pipeline: schema exploration, plan generation, plan clarification, SQL generation, and self-evaluation with retry. We implement all five stages with entity linking and Snowflake execution. In the 3-shot configuration, retrieved examples (with schema links and ID resolutions) are injected at plan generation to inform table selection and join paths. Self-evaluation re-executes and retries once on failure.
paragraphs.zh: FlexSQL 提出一个包含五个阶段的流程：模式探索、计划生成、计划澄清、SQL 生成以及带重试的自我评估。 我们使用实体关联和 Snowflake 执行来实现全部五个阶段。 在 3-shot 配置中，检索到的示例（包含模式链接和 ID 解析结果）会在计划生成阶段被注入，以指导表选择和连接路径的选择。 自我评估会在失败时重新执行并尝试一次。

paragraphs.en: The shared infrastructure (entity linking, lookup agent) given to DAIL-SQL, DIN-SQL, and FlexSQL makes our comparison conservative . Without it, these methods cannot resolve company names or reference-table IDs at all, and would achieve near-zero accuracy. We chose to give them the strongest possible implementation to demonstrate that the gap with FLINT is due to the generation strategy and domain-specific prompt engineering, not missing pre-processing. MAC-SQL, Chase-SQL, and ReFoRCE receive no shared infrastructure because their architectures are self-contained. MAC-SQL and ReFoRCE achieve entity resolution through database exploration, while Chase-SQL’s lack of any resolution mechanism is an inherent architectural limitation.
paragraphs.zh: DAIL-SQL、DIN-SQL 和 FlexSQL 所使用的共享基础设施（实体链接、查询智能体）使得我们的比较结果趋于保守。 如果没有它，这些方法根本无法解析公司名称或参考表 ID，其准确率将接近于零。 我们选择为它们提供尽可能强大的实现，以证明与 FLINT 的差距源于生成策略和领域特定的提示工程，而非缺少预处理。 MAC-SQL、Chase-SQL 和 ReFoRCE 没有共享基础设施，因为它们的架构是自包含的。 MAC-SQL 和 ReFoRCE 通过数据库探索实现实体解析，而 Chase-SQL 缺乏任何解析机制则是其架构固有的局限性。

paragraphs.en: We acknowledge several tensions in this evaluation:
paragraphs.zh: 我们注意到此次评估中存在几处张力：

paragraphs.en: DAIL-SQL and DIN-SQL within our pipeline: By providing entity linking and lookup, we are effectively comparing “ FLINT with generic prompts” against “ FLINT with domain-specific prompts.” A literal port of these methods (standalone, no infrastructure) yields near-zero accuracy and provides no useful signal. We believe that the current comparison better isolates the contribution of prompt engineering.
paragraphs.zh: 我们流程中的 DAIL-SQL 和 DIN-SQL：通过提供实体链接和查找功能，我们实际上是将“FLINT 搭配通用提示”与“FLINT 搭配领域特定提示”进行了比较。如果直接移植这些方法（独立运行，无基础设施支持），其准确率将接近于零，且无法提供任何有用的信号。 我们认为当前的比较更能准确区分提示工程所做出的贡献。

paragraphs.en: Chase-SQL without value retrieval: The original Chase-SQL uses LSH-based value retrieval to inject relevant column values into generator prompts. Our implementation omits this component, which may disadvantage Chase-SQL on entity-resolution-heavy queries. However, adapting LSH retrieval to our reference-table structure (where values are IDs rather than human-readable strings) would require non-trivial re-engineering that goes beyond the paper’s design.
paragraphs.zh: 不带值检索的 Chase-SQL：原始 Chase-SQL 使用基于 LSH 的值检索机制，将相关列值注入生成器提示中。 我们的实现省略了这一组件，这可能会使 Chase-SQL 在处理需要大量实体解析的查询时处于不利地位。 然而，要将 LSH 检索适配到我们的参考表结构（其中值是 ID 而非人类可读的字符串），需要进行非平凡的重新设计，而这超出了该论文的设计范围。

paragraphs.en: FLINT resolves 94%/75% of required IDs (Financials/Transactions); without its lookup agent, ID accuracy drops to 10%/7%, identical to Chase-SQL and 93–94% of failures become ID errors. Among baselines, Chase-SQL resolves all required IDs in only 6–7% of queries. DAIL-SQL and DIN-SQL receive both entity linking and the lookup agent, yet resolve IDs in only 21–29% of queries. This reveals that providing correct ID candidates is insufficient, domain-specific prompts are required to select the correct value among ambiguous options (e.g., distinguishing Total Revenue from Net Revenue, or choosing the correct period type). The gap between FLINT and DAIL/DIN is not infrastructure access but prompt-level domain knowledge that guides ID disambiguation.

paragraphs.en: The ablation confirms this diagnosis: removing FLINT ’s lookup agent reduces accuracy to 55%/33% (Financials/Transactions), comparable to the strongest baselines. The cleanest test holds the schema fixed: given FLINT ’s own schema links, DAIL/DIN retain ∼ 0.97 {\sim}0.97 table and 0.70–0.81 column overlap with gold, yet still score only 32–40%, so their remaining errors are wrong filter IDs, not wrong tables or columns, a value-grounding gap. Methods that prune aggressively instead lose the schema itself: MAC-SQL keeps only 0.39/0.20 of gold columns (Fin/Trans), and ReFoRCE’s iterative refinement prunes hard enough that overlap collapses, a distinct failure mode that Table 8 does not separate. Once the correct schema is supplied, value grounding is what remains.

paragraphs.en: Table 9 shows accuracy of FLINT stratified by structural complexity. Performance peaks on moderate queries (75%/70%), the system’s design point, where the standard join chain is well-covered by few-shot examples and lookup constraints. Simple queries (64%/66%) perform worse than moderate despite lower structural complexity. So we conduct a separate manual audit to understand this phenomenon. Crediting only failures that return the correct values while differing in a non-essential column/table raises effective accuracy from 68.8 % / 65.2 % 68.8\%/65.2\% to ∼ 85 % / ∼ 76 % {\sim}85\%/{\sim}76\% . We call this a presentation-only failure. The residual simple-query gap is not under-specification: of the eight simple-query failures on Financials, about half are presentation-only, and the genuine ones are entity-linking mistakes on otherwise-trivial questions and a tendency to over-engineer them (adding spurious currency conversion or extra joins). This over-engineering is the flip side of the robustness that helps on complex queries. Complex queries (54%/52%) degrade from compounding errors across 7+ joins.

sents.en: The schema linking stage is bypassed entirely.

paragraphs.en: When schema linking is removed, the model must select among hundreds of columns from the full schema text. Table overlap remains high (0.96) because the lookup constraints and retrieved examples still guide table selection implicitly, but column selection degrades.

paragraphs.en: We test whether evaluation accuracy could be explained by similarity between the retrieval query bank and the evaluation set. For each evaluation query we compute the normalized tree-edit distance (TED) to its nearest query bank neighbor over canonicalized sqlglot ASTs, in a content-aware mode where table/column names and literals contribute to the distance (the leakage-relevant measure). Overlap is reported as 1 − TED 1-\text{TED} .
paragraphs.zh: 我们检验评估准确性是否可以通过检索查询库与评估集之间的相似性来解释。 对于每个评估查询，我们在经过规范化的 sqlglot AST 上计算其与查询库中最近邻查询的归一化树编辑距离（TED），采用内容感知模式，其中表/列名和字面值都会对距离产生影响（这一度量与数据泄露相关）。 重叠度表示为 1 − TED 1−\text{TED}。

sents.en: We test whether evaluation accuracy could be explained by similarity between the retrieval query bank and the evaluation set.
sents.zh: 我们检验评估准确性是否可以通过检索查询库与评估集之间的相似性来解释。

sents.en: For each evaluation query we compute the normalized tree-edit distance (TED) to its nearest query bank neighbor over canonicalized sqlglot ASTs, in a content-aware mode where table/column names and literals contribute to the distance (the leakage-relevant measure).
sents.zh: 对于每个评估查询，我们在经过规范化的 sqlglot AST 上计算其与查询库中最近邻查询的归一化树编辑距离（TED），采用内容感知模式，其中表/列名和字面值都会对距离产生影响（这一度量与数据泄露相关）。

sents.en: Overlap is reported as 1 − TED 1-\text{TED} .
sents.zh: 重叠度表示为 1 − TED 1−\text{TED}。

paragraphs.en: Three points show overlap does not drive accuracy. (1) Control: baselines given the same bank (few-shot k = 3 k{=}3 , and DAIL/DIN/FlexSQL/ReFoRCE via the same retrieval) still trail by ∼ 20 {\sim}20 – 30 30 points; if overlap conferred accuracy they would inherit it. (2) Disjoint by construction: bank examples use a fixed canonical entity and share no question with the evaluation set, so even a structurally similar example filters on different entities/metrics/dates and is not answerable by copying. (3) Structural, not answer-level: the high structural similarity reflects a shared join backbone (a common multi-table chain plus currency handling) by design; the content-aware measure, which is the leak-relevant one, shows essentially no near-duplicates on Transactions.
paragraphs.zh: 三个数据点表明，重叠并未提升准确性。 （1）对照实验：基线模型在给定相同语料库（少样本 k = 3，以及通过相同检索获取的 DAIL/DIN/FlexSQL/ReFoRCE）的情况下，准确率仍低约 20–30 个点；如果重叠能带来准确性提升，它们本应继承这种优势。 （2）构造上完全分离：语料库中的示例使用固定的规范实体，且与评估集没有任何问题重叠，因此即使结构相似的示例，也会因涉及不同的实体、指标或日期而被过滤掉，无法通过直接复制得到答案。 （3）这是结构层面的相似性，而非答案层面的相似性：高度的结构相似性源于设计上的共同连接主干（一个通用的多表链式结构加上货币处理机制）；而关注内容差异的指标——即与数据泄露相关的指标——在“交易”数据集上几乎未显示出近似的重复样本。

sents.zh: （2）构造上完全分离：语料库中的示例使用固定的规范实体，且与评估集没有任何问题重叠，因此即使结构相似的示例，也会因涉及不同的实体、指标或日期而被过滤掉，无法通过直接复制得到答案。

sents.zh: （3）这是结构层面的相似性，而非答案层面的相似性：高度的结构相似性源于设计上的共同连接主干（一个通用的多表链式结构加上货币处理机制）；而关注内容差异的指标——即与数据泄露相关的指标——在“交易”数据集上几乎未显示出近似的重复样本。

paragraphs.en: To test whether FLINT ’s architecture transfers beyond finance, we evaluate on two external benchmarks spanning various scientific and industrial domains. For each, we adapt FLINT with only configuration changes, i.e. schema documentation, a query bank for retrieval, and domain-specific prompt rules, without any modification of the pipeline code. Our code is available at https://github.com/kensho-technologies/flint .
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试 FLINT 的架构能否超越金融领域实现迁移，我们在涵盖多个科学和工业领域的两个外部基准数据集上进行了评估。 对于每个基准，我们仅通过配置变更来适配 FLINT，即模式文档、用于检索的查询库以及领域特定的提示规则，而无需对流程代码进行任何修改。 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/kensho-technologies/flint 获取。

paragraphs.en: SM3-Text-to-Query ( Sivasubramaniam et al., 2024 ) is a medical benchmark over Synthea synthetic patient data (19 PostgreSQL tables, SNOMED/LOINC/RxNorm codes as opaque identifiers). The high few-shot baseline reflects structural simplicity: 68% of questions are single-table. FLINT ’s gains concentrate on the harder slices, i.e. multi-table-join accuracy reaches 97% and unanswerable-question detection 97%, versus 90% and 42% for few-shot.
paragraphs.zh: SM3-Text-to-Query（Sivasubramaniam 等人，2024）是一个基于 Synthea 合成患者数据（包含 19 个 PostgreSQL 表，以及作为不透明标识符的 SNOMED/LOINC/RxNorm 代码）的医学基准。 高 few-shot 基线反映了其结构上的简单性：68% 的问题仅涉及单表查询。 FLINT 的性能提升主要集中在更复杂的任务上，即多表连接准确率达到了 97%，无法回答的问题检测率也达到了 97%，而 few-shot 方法在这两项指标上分别为 90% 和 42%。

paragraphs.en: ScienceBenchmark ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) provides a harder test: three PostgreSQL databases from distinct scientific domains where even few-shot achieves only 50–82%. CORDIS (EU research funding, 19 tables) requires navigating a complex many-to-many schema linking projects, institutions, and funding programmes. OncoMX (cancer biomarkers, 25 tables) demands correct join paths through a deep foreign-key graph connecting genes, diseases, and clinical tests. SDSS (astronomical surveys, 6 tables, 4.2M rows) tests retrieval over a wide-column photometric catalog with domain-specific type lookups.
paragraphs.zh: ScienceBenchmark（Zhang 等人，2023）提出了一个更具挑战性的测试：三个来自不同科学领域的 PostgreSQL 数据库，其中即使是少样本学习也仅能达到 50–82% 的准确率。 CORDIS（欧盟研究资助项目，19 张表）要求导航一个复杂的多对多模式，该模式将项目、机构和资助计划相互关联。 OncoMX（癌症生物标志物，25 张表）需要通过一个连接基因、疾病和临床检测的深层外键图，正确找到连接路径。 SDSS（天文巡天，6 张表，420 万行）测试了在一个宽列光度测量目录中进行检索的能力，该目录包含领域特定的类型查找。

paragraphs.en: FLINT improves over few-shot in every domain, by as much as 14 points.(Fig. 6 and Tab. 11 ). The gains come from the same components: Retrieval demonstrates correct join patterns for the domain’s schema topology, domain rules enforce conventions (case sensitivity, operator choice, table-specific semantics), and execution-based reflection recovers from wrong join paths by detecting empty results. No architectural changes are required; only the configuration layer adapts to each domain.
paragraphs.zh: FLINT 在所有领域都优于少样本方法，性能提升高达 14 分。（图 6 和表 11） 这些提升源于相同的组件：检索模块能够识别出与领域模式拓扑结构相符的正确连接模式，领域规则则强制执行相关规范（如大小写敏感性、算子选择以及表特定的语义），而基于执行的反思机制则通过检测空结果来纠正错误的连接路径。 无需进行任何架构上的改动；只需将配置层适配到每个领域即可。

paragraphs.en: FLINT serves production traffic against a multi-terabyte financial database. Unlike offline evaluation, deployment has no gold queries, so the system must ensure safety and detect failures without ground truth supervision.
paragraphs.zh: FLINT 为生产流量服务，其背后是一个容量达数 TB 的金融数据库。 与离线评估不同，部署环境没有标准查询集，因此系统必须确保安全性并能在没有标准答案监督的情况下检测故障。

paragraphs.en: All generated SQL executes through a read-only connection with row-level access controls. Queries are rejected at the gateway if they reference tables or columns outside the user’s entitlement scope. A structural validator inspects every query before execution, blocking statements that contain mutation keywords, unbounded scans without WHERE clauses, or joins exceeding a configurable fan-out threshold. Query execution is subject to per-session resource limits (timeout, memory, result-set size) enforced by the warehouse, preventing runaway queries from degrading shared infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 所有生成的 SQL 都通过只读连接执行，并具备行级访问控制。 如果查询引用了超出用户权限范围的表或列，将在网关处被拒绝。 结构验证器在执行前会检查每个查询，阻止包含变更关键字、没有 WHERE 子句的无限制扫描或超过可配置扇出阈值的连接语句。 查询执行受仓库实施的每会话资源限制（超时、内存、结果集大小）约束，防止失控查询降低共享基础设施的性能。

paragraphs.en: Without ground truth, we rely on proxy signals to detect degradation. Execution failures (syntax errors, permission violations, timeouts) provide an unambiguous error signal and trigger immediate retry via the reflection loop. For semantically wrong but executable queries, we monitor result set anomalies: empty results for questions that should return data, unexpectedly large result sets, and null ratios inconsistent with the queried tables. User feedback (explicit ratings and implicit signals such as re-asking a rephrased question) provides a sparse but high-quality correctness signal. Aggregate metrics (execution success rate, median latency, and user satisfaction scores) are tracked over rolling windows; sustained degradation triggers review of the retrieval index and prompt templates.
paragraphs.zh: 在没有基准事实的情况下，我们依赖代理信号来检测性能退化。 执行失败（语法错误、权限违规、超时）会提供明确的错误信号，并通过反射循环立即触发重试。 对于语义上错误但可执行的查询，我们会监控结果集异常：本应返回数据的查询却得到空结果、结果集意外过大，以及查询表与结果中的空值比例不符等情况。 用户反馈（明确评分和隐式信号，例如重新提出改写后的问题）提供了稀疏但高质量的准确性信号。 我们会通过滚动窗口跟踪汇总指标（执行成功率、中位数延迟和用户满意度得分）；若出现持续的性能退化，则会触发对检索索引和提示模板的审查。

paragraphs.en: Outside of multi-agent systems, earlier prompt-engineering approaches tackle the problem without multi-agent orchestration. DAIL-SQL Gao et al. (2024) uses token-level similarity for few-shot selection with a structured format separating schema from examples, while DIN-SQL Pourreza and Rafiei (2023) decomposes the task into sub-problems with self-correction. Both methods indicate that prompt structure matters, but neither includes mechanisms for finding values that appear in the question or schema text (the Lookup Agent 3.1 in FLINT ).
paragraphs.zh: 在多智能体系统之外，早期的提示工程方法在没有多智能体协调的情况下解决该问题。DAIL-SQL Gao 等人 （2024）使用词元级别的相似性进行少样本选择，并通过结构化格式将模式与示例分离；而 DIN-SQL Pourreza 和 Rafiei（2023）则将任务分解为带有自我修正的子问题。 这两种方法都表明提示结构很重要，但两者都没有包含用于查找问题或模式文本中出现的值的机制（即 FLINT 中的查找智能体 3.1）。

paragraphs.en: A separate line of work focuses on schema-linking as a pre-processing step to reduce the amount of tokens presented to the SQL generator. C3-SQL Dong et al. (2023) uses ChatGPT to identify relevant schemas through zero-reasoning. RESDSQL Li et al. (2023a) trains a separate ranking model to select relevant tables and columns to then pass a pruned schema to the generator. On normalized schemas, we have the extra challenge of not only identifying target tables (where the answer resides), but also bridge tables that are used for foreign-key traversal. FLINT addresses this by using join paths, resolved lookup constraints, and similar retrieved examples to guide bridge-table identification.
paragraphs.zh: 另一项独立的研究将模式关联作为预处理步骤，以减少呈现给 SQL 生成器的令牌数量。C3-SQL Dong 等人 (2023) 使用 ChatGPT 通过零样本推理识别相关模式。RESDSQL Li 等人 (2023a) 训练了一个独立的排序模型来选择相关的表和列，然后将修剪后的模式传递给生成器。 在规范化模式下，我们面临的额外挑战不仅是识别目标表（答案所在之处），还要识别用于外键遍历的桥接表。 FLINT 通过利用连接路径、已解析的查找约束以及类似的检索示例来指导桥接表的识别，从而解决了这一问题。
